collections_page.empty.description: Collections page, when the library has no collections: one sentence naming the library (No collections in Films). Shown in the middle of the page, so keep it short.

collections_page.playlist_tab.description: Top navigation tab for the active server’s playlists.

collections_page.playlist_kind.description: Media type in the playlist detail header.

collections_page.playlist_heading.description: Heading above the directory of video playlists.

collections_page.playlist_order.description: Heading above the ordered members of a playlist.

collections_page.playlist_shuffle.description: Button to play the videos in random order.

collections_page.playlist_shuffle_failed.description: Shuffle button after a request fails. Selecting it retries.

collections_page.playlist_shuffling.description: Shuffle button while the server prepares the queue.

collections_page.playlist_empty_director.value: No video playlists on this server
collections_page.playlist_empty_director.description: Empty state when the server has no video playlists.

collections_page.playlist_empty_members.value: No playable videos in this playlist
collections_page.playlist_empty_members.description: Empty state when a playlist has no playable video members.

collections_page.playlist_queue_failed.value: Could not open this playlist at the selected video. Reopen the playlist and try again.
collections_page.playlist_queue_failed.description: Playback error when the server cannot resolve the selected occurrence in the playlist.

collections_page.playlist_unavailable.value: Playlists are unavailable for this profile
collections_page.playlist_unavailable.description: Read-out when the server denies playlist access or the playlist no longer exists.
